status.current: continues toward Seven Stars after surviving Edelweiss and Akatsuki's attack
status.opening_match: drawn against reigning Seven Stars Sword King Yuudai Moroboshi
status.relationship: openly possessive and affectionate toward Stella after proposing

personality.summary: Gentle, analytical and self-sacrificing; increasingly open about wanting Stella as his woman, and willing to risk death for Shizuku's first request to him as a brother.

relationships.stella-vermillion: Fiancee/girlfriend; he becomes more demonstratively possessive and supports her training frustrations.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Sister; he escorts her to rescue Alice and stakes his life to keep Edelweiss from following her.
relationships.nagi-arisuin: Chooses to trust Alice's confession and counter-plan despite the risk.
relationships.ouma-kurogane: Estranged elder brother now in Akatsuki; Ouma rejects family ties.
relationships.amane-shinomiya: Initially helped during a random-killer incident, but feels a deep irrational aversion and later identifies his future-prediction trap.
relationships.edelweiss: Duels the world strongest swordswoman and leaves a tiny wound despite losing.

periods.summary: Ikki dominates the Yamagata joint training camp enough that Hagun must call Nango as a special coach, and he informally coaches the Hagure sisters. He and Stella meet Amane after stopping a random killer, but Ikki feels a disturbing omen around the friendly boy. During Akatsuki's attack he accepts Alice's defection plan, then realizes Amane has used foresight to counter it. He follows Shizuku to rescue Alice and confronts Edelweiss at Akatsuki's base. Although utterly outclassed, he fights with Ittou Shura, Perfect Vision and his secret swords, persists after Intetsu is shattered, wins Edelweiss's recognition as a swordsman, and even draws a few drops of her blood. Afterward he chooses to enter Seven Stars despite the state-backed Akatsuki plot and is bracketed against reigning champion Yuudai Moroboshi in round one.

key_events.summary: Stops a random killer and meets Amane, whose friendliness unsettles him.
Trusts Alice's confession and authorizes the counter-ambush.
Faces the world strongest swordswoman to protect Shizuku's wish.
Learns his first Seven Stars opponent is the current champion.
